core_obligations: Reduction (proof lines 5688-5710): the base bijection plus base change reduce to B = Y'.
Full faithfulness (proof lines 5712-5726): Isom is an algebraic space over B, and the Artin pushout lemma gives bijectivity over the pushout square.
Essential surjectivity, descent (proof lines 5728-5751): the triple glues to E_{Y'} via the derived pushout lemma applied to the induced pushout square of spaces.
Perfectness (proof lines 5752-5760): condition (2) is pointwise and Y, Y' have the same points; relative perfectness transfers along the thickening.
proof_roadmap: Prove full faithfulness via the pushout property of Isom (proof lines 5712-5726).
Descend the triple to E_{Y'} (proof lines 5728-5751).
